scope: Editorial starter catalogue; GitHub star snapshots, not a live trending ranking. Source review is not an installation or security audit.

tools.name: Excalidraw

task.zh: 画一张手绘风格流程图

description.zh: 把想法画成白板、流程图或线框图，导出图片。
description.en: Turn an idea into a whiteboard, flowchart or wireframe and export an image.

cost.zh: 基础在线画板免费；Excalidraw+ 是另一个付费产品。
cost.en: The basic web editor is free; Excalidraw+ is a separate paid product.

caution.zh: 浏览器保存不能代替备份；离开前导出可编辑文件。
caution.en: Browser storage is not a backup. Export an editable file before leaving.

zh: 打开官方画板，无需 GitHub 账户。
用方框、箭头和文字说明一个流程。
导出 PNG / SVG，并保存 .excalidraw 源文件。
en: Open the official editor; no GitHub account needed.
Use boxes, arrows and text to explain a process.
Export PNG / SVG and save the editable .excalidraw file.

tools.keywords: 白板 流程图 思维导图 画图 diagram flowchart whiteboard wireframe

tools.name: draw.io

task.zh: 画工作流程和组织结构图
task.en: Draw a workflow or organization chart

description.zh: 从图形和模板开始，整理步骤、关系与系统结构。
description.en: Start with shapes and templates to organize steps, relationships and systems.

cost.zh: 在线编辑器免费；部分平台集成另收费。
cost.en: The web editor is free; some platform integrations are paid.

caution.zh: 存储位置由你选择；先确认文件保存在设备还是所选云盘。
caution.en: Choose where the file lives: your device or your selected cloud storage.

zh: 打开编辑器，选择保存到设备或自己的存储。
创建空白图或选模板，拖动图形并连接。
保存可编辑图，再导出 PNG 或 PDF。
en: Open the editor and choose device or your own storage.
Create a blank diagram or template; connect shapes.
Save the editable diagram, then export PNG or PDF.

tools.keywords: 流程图 组织架构 架构图 画图 diagram flowchart chart visio

tools.name: Squoosh

task.zh: 把图片压小，比较清晰度
task.en: Shrink an image and compare quality

description.zh: 在浏览器中压缩、转换图片，用分屏预览比较处理前后。
description.en: Compress and convert an image in the browser, comparing before and after.

cost.zh: 网页工具免费，无需服务器部署。
cost.en: Free web tool; no server deployment needed.

caution.zh: 官方说明图片在本地处理，但会收集部分使用统计；不是零遥测。
caution.en: The project says images are processed locally, but some usage analytics are collected.

zh: 打开官网，选择一张图片。
选择格式与质量，比较预览和体积。
下载结果，确认细节仍符合用途。
en: Open the app and choose one image.
Choose a format and quality; compare preview and size.
Download the result and check the details.

tools.keywords: 图片压缩 压缩图片 图片太大 照片 转格式 jpg png webp compress image photo

tools.name: LocalSend

task.en: Send files between phone and computer

description.zh: 通过同一个本地网络向附近设备发送文件，不依赖云盘中转。
description.en: Send files to nearby devices on the same local network without cloud storage.

cost.zh: 应用免费；不包含跨互联网远程传输服务。
cost.en: Free app; this does not include a remote internet transfer service.

caution.zh: 两台设备需可互相访问；访客 Wi-Fi 隔离或防火墙可能阻止发现。
caution.en: Devices must reach each other; guest Wi-Fi isolation or a firewall can block discovery.

zh: 在两台设备安装对应系统的官方版本。
连接同一个本地网络，在发送端选择文件和接收设备。
在接收端确认，再检查收到的文件。
en: Install the official app on both devices.
Join the same local network; choose files and the receiving device.
Accept on the receiving device and check the files.

tools.keywords: 传文件 文件传输 手机电脑互传 安卓 苹果 airdrop transfer send files

tools.name: HandBrake

task.zh: 压缩视频，转换播放格式
task.en: Compress a video or change its format

description.zh: 把已有视频转成 MP4、MKV 或 WebM，调整画质与体积。
description.en: Convert an existing video to MP4, MKV or WebM and adjust quality and file size.

cost.zh: 桌面工具免费；编码消耗本机时间与算力。
cost.en: Free desktop app; encoding uses your computer and takes time.

caution.zh: 不处理 DRM 保护的视频；压缩不保证无损，也不是剪辑软件。
caution.en: Does not process DRM-protected video. Compression may lose quality; this is not a video editor.

zh: 下载正式版并打开一段自己的视频。
先选适合用途的预设，指定新的输出文件名。
开始编码，检查画质和声音后再处理更多文件。
en: Install the stable release and open your video.
Choose a suitable preset and a new output filename.
Encode, then check picture and sound before processing more files.

tools.keywords: 视频压缩 压缩视频 视频太大 转码 mp4 compress video convert

tools.name: Shotcut

task.zh: 剪一段视频，添加字幕和声音
task.en: Edit a video with text and sound

description.zh: 用时间线拼接片段、剪掉多余部分，再导出成片。
description.en: Arrange clips on a timeline, trim unwanted parts and export a video.

cost.zh: 本地应用免费；下载渠道或可选服务可能另收费。
cost.en: The local app is free; distribution channels or optional services may charge separately.

caution.zh: 需要学习时间线与导出设置；长视频的流畅度取决于设备。
caution.en: Expect to learn the timeline and export settings; long projects depend on your hardware.

zh: 从官方下载页选择系统版本。
导入素材到时间线，先完成一次简单剪切。
保存项目，再用导出功能生成视频文件。
en: Choose your operating system on the official download page.
Add clips to the timeline and make a simple cut.
Save the project, then export a video file.

tools.keywords: 剪辑 视频剪辑 剪视频 字幕 capcut video editor trim

tools.name: OBS Studio

task.zh: 录屏讲解，制作操作演示
task.en: Record your screen for a tutorial

description.zh: 把屏幕、窗口、摄像头和麦克风组合成录屏或直播。
description.en: Combine screen, window, camera and microphone sources for recording or streaming.

cost.zh: 录制软件免费；直播平台及第三方服务另算。
cost.en: The recorder is free; streaming platforms and third-party services have their own terms.

caution.zh: 先检查系统录屏与麦克风权限，避免录入无关窗口或声音。
caution.en: Check capture and microphone permissions, and keep unrelated windows or audio out of the recording.

zh: 安装官方版本，运行自动配置向导。
添加窗口或显示器来源，检查麦克风电平。
先录一小段，回放确认画面与声音。
en: Install the official version and run the configuration wizard.
Add a window or display source and check microphone levels.
Make a short recording and play it back to check video and audio.

tools.keywords: 录屏 屏幕录制 直播 教程 screen recording record streaming

tools.name: Audacity

task.zh: 剪音频，整理录音和播客

description.zh: 录制声音、剪掉片段，调整音量并导出音频。
description.en: Record sound, cut sections, adjust levels and export an audio file.

cost.zh: 基础录音与编辑免费；插件和云服务按各自条件。
cost.en: Basic recording and editing are free; plugins and cloud services have separate terms.

caution.zh: 工程文件与成品音频不同；交付前需要导出并试听。
caution.en: A project file is not the finished audio; export and listen before delivery.

zh: 选择适合系统的官方安装包。
导入录音或开始录制，选择不需要的片段剪除。
保存工程，再导出音频并试听。
en: Choose the official installer for your system.
Import or record audio; select and remove unwanted sections.
Save the project, export audio and listen to the result.

tools.keywords: 剪音频 录音 音频剪辑 播客 降噪 audio podcast recording edit

tools.name: Joplin

description.zh: 创建笔记本，保存文字与附件，并选择自己的同步方式。
description.en: Create notebooks, keep text and attachments, and choose a synchronization service.

cost.zh: 本地笔记应用免费；Joplin Cloud 订阅另收费。
cost.en: The local notes app is free; Joplin Cloud requires a separate subscription.

caution.zh: 跨设备同步需要配置同步目标；云空间不随开源应用免费附送。
caution.en: Cross-device sync needs a configured target; cloud storage is not included merely because the app is open source.

zh: 安装应用，创建一个笔记本和测试笔记。
加入文字与附件，确认本机可再次打开。
需要同步时再选择服务，并先做备份。
en: Install the app and create a notebook and test note.
Add text and an attachment; reopen it locally.
If you need sync, choose a service and make a backup first.

tools.keywords: 笔记 记事 待办 知识库 印象笔记 notion evernote notes notebook

tools.name: KeePassXC

description.zh: 把登录资料保存在由你掌管的加密数据库文件中。
description.en: Keep login details in an encrypted database file you control.

cost.zh: 桌面软件免费，不包含代管与密码恢复服务。
cost.en: Free desktop software; no managed storage or password-recovery service is included.

caution.zh: 牢记主密码并备份数据库；忘记解锁信息可能无法恢复。
caution.en: Keep the master password and a database backup safe; losing unlock credentials can mean losing access.

zh: 安装正式版，按入门指南创建数据库。
设置可靠的主密码，先添加一个测试条目。
确认能重新打开，并把数据库备份到合适位置。
en: Install a stable release and create a database using the guide.
Set a strong master password and add a test entry.
Confirm you can reopen it and back up the database appropriately.

tools.keywords: 密码 密码管理 本地 隐私 password manager vault

tools.name: ShareX

description.zh: 在 Windows 上截图、添加标注并保存操作素材。
description.en: Capture and annotate screenshots on Windows for instructions and handovers.

cost.zh: 应用免费；所选外部上传服务按各自条件。
cost.en: The app is free; external upload services have their own terms.

caution.zh: 检查截图后的任务设置；启用上传会把内容发送到所选服务。
caution.en: Check after-capture tasks: enabling upload sends content to the selected service.

zh: 从官网安装 Windows 版本。
先检查截图后任务，按需要关闭自动上传。
截取区域，标注后保存到本机。
en: Install the Windows version from the official site.
Review after-capture tasks and disable automatic upload if unwanted.
Capture a region, annotate it and save locally.

tools.keywords: 截图 截屏 标注 长截图 screenshot capture annotate windows

tools.name: Immich

description.zh: 在自己的服务器上管理照片，并配合手机应用上传。
description.en: Manage photos on your own server and upload from the mobile app.

cost.zh: 软件可自托管；硬件、存储、电力和维护需要自行承担。
cost.en: Self-hostable software; you pay for hardware, storage, electricity and maintenance.

caution.zh: 进阶项：需要 Docker 和服务器维护能力；先设计备份，不要把它当唯一副本。
caution.en: Advanced: requires Docker and server maintenance. Plan backups and do not use it as your only copy.

zh: 先核对官方服务器和存储要求。
按官方快速入门配置服务器，再连接手机应用。
用测试照片验证上传、导出和备份恢复后再迁移。
en: Check the official server and storage requirements.
Follow the server quick start, then connect the mobile app.
Test upload, export and backup recovery before migrating photos.

tools.keywords: 相册 照片备份 照片管理 私有云 google photos photo backup library
